beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Dave lays three cards down. "Let's see the whole shape of the last year."

beats.prompt: The past: the chain you finally admitted was already loose.
The present: the people you let back in instead of carrying it alone.
The future: the success now bright enough for the paper to notice.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Quiz me. If I share the credit, doesn't that make the success feel smaller?"

options.text: No — the warmth radiates outward either way; sharing it doesn't shrink it.
It does — credit's a fixed pie.
The Sun doesn't have anything to do with credit.

elaboration: Warmth, success, and vitality radiate outward in this card — none of that shrinks by including someone else in the story.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Should I just get in front of every camera and interview from now on?"

options.text: Sometimes the wiser move is to step back and let it unfold without you in every shot.
Yes — take every opportunity you can get.
The Sun says press attention doesn't matter at all.

elaboration: Sometimes the wisest move with this card is to step back and simply watch things unfold, instead of putting yourself at the center of every frame.

beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: "One thread ties all three: the habit you set down, the people you let carry some of the weight, and the light that's bright now because of both."

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Yeah. I think this one's actually mine to enjoy — I just don't need to stand in front of it alone. Thank you."
